gatherings.title: Gatherins & Events
gatherings.lede: Whit’s comin up, hou gatherins wirk, whaur we land, an the memory o past calls.
gatherings.whatBody: If ye hae niver been, ye mey wunner whit happens. Activities chynge frae ae gatherin tae the next. Whit tends tae return is a fluid, diverse queer space whaur fowk o mony ages, races, bodies, sexualities, genders, an beliefs come thegither — liberatin for some, unfamilar for ithers. If ye're new, ye can chat wi an organiser first. If yer hert is awready sayin aye, listen tae that.
gatherings.coBody: Faeries say: if ye see somethin that needs daein, the best wey is tae dae it. A team helps aforehaund; the event itsel happens acause o wha comes. Fowk chip in — meals, dishes, wid, wirkshops, hert circles, entertainment, sweepin up. Naethin particular is obligatory; participation is the gatherin.
gatherings.lifeBody: We eat thegither — vegetarian wi vegan options, cooked in the kitchen by whae'er wants tae help. Hert circles aften rin freer o ceety time-pressure an can open profoond sharin. Wirkshops an activities mey include ritual, dancin, drummin, theatre, music, airt, gemmes, fancy dress, silence, solitude, chaos, an mair. If ye bring it, it will maist likely happen.
gatherings.careBody: A gatherin aims tae be inclusive, safe, an supportin. Organisers mey speak wi fowk whan behaviour causes conflict, an mey ask someone tae leave tae protect the hail. It isnae group counsellin — ye haud responsibility for yer ain personal, emotional, physical, an sexual safety. Hert circles, unnerstandin faeries, hugs, an organisers are aroond wi support an luve.
gatherings.payBody: Bank details are shared efter bookin; cash at the gatherin is fine tae. We haud NOTAFLOF close — No One Turned Away For Lack Of Funds. Gatherins are non-profit; addeetional donations are gratefully received.
gatherings.featherBody: Near Haltwhistle and Hadrian's Wall — log fires, shared feasts, heart circles, dancing, drumming, and a drag room.
gatherings.glastoBody: A 43-acre organic farm at the foot of the Tor — long-house kitchens, house beds, and camping when the weather softens.
gatherings.placesIntro: Castles, farms, lodges, an quieter land Circles return tae. Tap a hearth for travel, beds, access, an whit tae expect.
gatherings.featherUsed: Samhain · Ostara · autumn and spring gatherins
gatherings.glastoUsed: Imbolc · Beltane · summer and spring gatherins
gatherings.pardshawBody: Near Cockermouth in the Lake District. Communal sleepin across meetin rooms, wood stove, limited campin in the burial grund, nae wifi. Intimate capacity — aboot 20 indoors an 5 campin.
gatherings.anybodyUsed: Queer Earth Resistance and special gatherins
gatherings.anybodyBody: A smaaer rural barn venue uised for focused co-created gatherins ootside the usual festival calendar.
gatherings.sussexBody: Basic campin on a private estate recommendit by faeries wha gathered there — private, naitural, an quieter than castle buikins whan numbers need a different scale.
gatherings.balcombeBody: A soothren campin / residential hearth uised for summer Sussex gatherins.
gatherings.bridwellUsed: Queer Spirit Festival · Radical Faerie presence
gatherings.bridwellBody: No an Albion-owned venue — festival land whaur Albion Faeries join the wider queer spiritual wab for play, ritual, an camp.
gatherings.venuesNote: Plannin a gatherin on new land? Write tae Gatherings and Events via Get involved.
gatherings.featherExpectBody: A collaborative, co-created gathering — cook, chop wood, hold workshops, keep the castle cared for. The drag room offers a new outfit for every adventure.
gatherings.featherPractical1: Vegetarian and vegan meals. The castle can be cold — bring warm layers, slippers, outdoor clothes, boots, and a torch. Bring your own bedding and pillowcase; beds and mattresses are plentiful.
gatherings.featherPractical2: Baths and showers with hot water — bring towels. Fancy dress welcome in the drag room. Auctions often help fund the gathering.
gatherings.featherPractical3: Also useful: decorations, musical instruments, a flashlight, books, games, waterproofs, a hot water bottle, an electric heater if you can, altar items, art supplies, performance music, and cash for the auction or on-site payment.
gatherings.featherAccess: Ground floor is wheelchair accessible; dining and most social spaces are upstairs by stairs.
gatherings.featherAddress: Featherstone Castle, Hall Bank, Northumberland NE49 0JG — outside Haltwhistle, near Hadrian’s Wall.
gatherings.featherAir: By air: Newcastle, then train to Haltwhistle.
gatherings.featherTrain: Train via Carlisle or Newcastle to Haltwhistle — book early.
gatherings.featherCar: By car: three miles south-west of Haltwhistle on the A69.
gatherings.featherArrive: Arrive from noon on the first day; leave by noon on the last.
gatherings.glastoExpect1: A 43-acre organic farm at the foot of Glastonbury Tor. Gatherings are co-created — a core team holds the call and food; once we arrive, every contribution is welcome.
gatherings.glastoExpect2: Heart circles, shared vegan/vegetarian meals in the long-house kitchen, and daily tasks. If you see something that needs doing, why not be the one to do it?
gatherings.glastoExpect3: Happenings may include workshops, ritual, dancing, drumming, theatre, music, art, sensuality, games, fancy dress, silence, solitude, serenity, chaos, noise, and drama. Whatever else happens, there will be magic.
gatherings.glastoPractical1: Rooms across several buildings; some uneven paths. Camping in warmer weather. Tell us access needs in advance. House beds usually include duvet, pillow, and bedding.
gatherings.glastoPractical2: Bring fancy dress for the drag room if you like, auction gifts, wellies, slippers, wet-weather gear, and note dietary needs on the booking form.
gatherings.glastoArrive: Arrive after 4pm on the first day; leave by 11am on departure day.
gatherings.glastoAddress: Paddington Farm Trust, Maidencroft Lane, Glastonbury BA6 8JN — about 30 minutes’ walk from town.
gatherings.glastoTrain: Train: London Paddington to Bristol or Taunton, then bus onward.
gatherings.glastoBus: Bus: Berrys to Glastonbury; National Express / Megabus to Bristol then local bus.
gatherings.glastoDrive: By car: approach from the west via Brindham Lane (what3words ///steady.rezoning.spurted). From the M25: M3 west, A303, then via Castle Cary / Shepton Mallet / Pilton onto the A361 toward Glastonbury; turn for Wick / Brindham Lane and follow signs to Maidencroft Farm.
gatherings.laughtonBody: Near Lewes on the edge of the South Downs — meadows, woodland, a sprung-floor hall, kitchen, guest rooms, and a fire-pit patio.
gatherings.laughtonExpect1: Laughton Lodge is a residential community on the edge of the South Downs, near Lewes — about 15 minutes from Lewes and 30 from Brighton. Albion Faeries gathered here for Lughnasadh, landing among meadows, woodland, gardens, and shared outdoor space.
gatherings.laughtonExpect2: The Shawfield event spaces include a large sprung-floor hall, professional kitchen, dining room, music room, guest rooms, and a patio with a fire pit — a southern hearth for ritual, feast, drumming, and rest under summer skies.
gatherings.laughtonPractical: Expect a rural community setting with indoor gathering rooms and outdoor land to roam. Bring layers for cool evenings, outdoor footwear, and whatever helps you settle into a co-created summer gathering. Exact bedding and capacity notes live with each gathering’s call when it opens.
gatherings.laughtonAddress: Laughton Lodge, Common Lane, Lewes, BN8 6BY — roughly 6 miles from Lewes, 15 from Brighton, and about 90 minutes from central London. Nearest stations: Lewes and Uckfield. Free parking on site.
gatherings.glastoDriveShort: By car: approach from the west via Brindham Lane (///steady.rezoning.spurted).

who.title: Wha we are
who.lede: An ever-expandin collective in the global Faerie wab — speerit, sexuality, an chosen commonty across Albion.
who.todayBody: The Faeries of Albion are an ever-expanding collective network of lesbians, gay men, trans*, bisexuals, queer hetero people and anyone else in between, who come together to create vibrant, energetic and safe spaces to celebrate the spirituality in our sexuality; to develop our skills as healers, shamans and ritual workers; and as drummers, storytellers, performers, poets and artists, as well as community organisers, activists, and chefs.
who.heartBody: We appreciate and celebrate nature by communing with her spirits through play and ritual and explore a profound love for each other and the world through coming together in heart circle — a way of opening to one another sensitively and supporting any revelation or experience, with unconditional love.
who.webBody: The Albion Faeries are part of the global faerie web, connecting awakening, nature-loving, compassionate queers the world over.
who.circlesBody: Day-tae-day wirk rins throu Core Circles onybody mey join: Finance, Communications, an Gatherins & Events. We aim for open, transparent meetins; major decisions gang throu Circles or Faessemblies. Convenors keep Circles meetin; Record-keepers keep minutes, archives, an follow-throu alive. Roles are service, ideally pledged for aboot a year, wi elder an neophyte backups whaur we can.
who.heartCircleBody: A Radical Faerie tradeetion for open, honest, lovin communication. Fowk meet in sacred space tae speak frae the hert an be listened tae frae the hert — wi confidentiality, "I" statements, nae debate or interruption, an a talisman that hauds ilk person's turn. Naebody haes tae speak. It isnae formal therapy, yet witnessin an bein witnessed can be deeply healin.
who.spiritBody: We are proud to be part of the expansion of gay/queer life into the realms of the heart and spirit; to promote self awareness, expression and growth; and to be part of the renewal of Albion as a magical island where the wonders of spirit manifest.
who.faeriesP1: The Faeries are gay men and women plus men and women who prefer to use any other moniker that might describe them plus people that choose not to be called men or women plus beings who choose not to be called people. Faeries are organized as a group attempting to create community out of ritual and cooperation, except for faeries who are attempting to create community out of subversion of process and structure, as well as some faeries who wish to create chaos, often celebrating it, often not admitting it.
who.faeriesP2: Many faeries are spiritual, lifting whole or part of their spirituality from any one of the world’s religions or spiritualities. Some make up their own. Some make a mix. Some react against spirituality and religion as its own evil, some find a spiritual path in reacting against spirituality.
who.faeriesP3: Some Faeries just want to dress up in drag and perform in the woods, some want to dress up and not perform, some faeries want to dress up anywhere they can, some faeries don’t dress particularly different than they would in any other environment.
who.faeriesP4: Some faeries combine their spirituality with sex, some don’t, some are part of the faeries just to get laid. Some resent that. Some just want to drum by a camp-fire, and some want to camp far away from the drumming and get some sleep.
who.faeriesP5: This is what faeries are, except for faeries for which none of this applies.

involve.title: Get involved
involve.lede: We are an informal netwirk o connectit individuals. Come tae a circle or gatherin, join the mailin leet, or find us on Faenet an Facebook.
involve.comeBody: Start wi Gatherins & Events. Nae application form — arrive wi care. If ye're new tae Faerie or queer space, ye can write first an ask.
involve.newsBody: Gatherin calls, bookin openins, an ither events. Sign up on the Albion Faeries newsletter leet.
involve.connectBody: Faenet is a private Faerie social space. The Facebook group Radical Faerie UK has regional links and gathering chat.
involve.contactBody: General questions: faerieuk@gmail.com. Circle invites an organisin: info@albionfaeries.org.uk. Prefer a form tae a named Circle? Uise the contact paths Circles awready ken — Comms, Finance, Gatherins & Events, Diversity & Inclusivity, or newsletter items.
involve.donateBody: Albion Faeries are entirely volunteer-run an no for profit. Donations sustain NOTAFLOF — helpin fowk reach gatherins wha mey no itherwise — an cover smaa costs sic as hostin.
involve.donateBank: Co-operative Bank · Account name Faerie UK · Sort code 08-92-99 · Account 65488214 · Reference Donation
involve.donateNote: Ae-aff or regular gifts by bank transfer are preferred; PayPal is also uised on the legacy site.
involve.circleBody: For faeries wha awready haud Circle wirk — notes, actions, an templates ahint a quate threshold.
involve.circlesHowIntro: Albion Faeries dinnae seek tae be bund by strict policies, but tae share an grow values, ethics, an principles thegither in mutual luve an respect. Meetins an decisions aim tae be as open an transparent as possible — wi nae formal membership, an an invitation tae thae wha identify as pairt o the Radical Faeries o Albion.
involve.circlesHow1: No aabody can be present at aathing; a public mail-oot keeps fowk in the loop.
involve.circlesHow2: Hosts o private meetin spaces mey say wha gets their address.
involve.circlesHow3: Workin pairties haundle focused detail; Faessemblies are open potentially tae aw radical faeries.
involve.circlesHow4: Faessembly an Core Circle meetins shuid be advertised wi due notice. Major decisions gang throu Core Circles or Faessemblies — workin groups arenae empowered tae decide for the hail commonty.
involve.circlesHow5: Muckle residential gatherins include a general assembly; Stewards aim for these at least twice a year in different pairts o Albion.
involve.circlesMapCaption: Frae open Faessembly, throu Stewards, intae the three Core Circles that dae the day-tae-day wirk - wi workin pairties feedin detail back up.
involve.circlesCoreIntro: Day-tae-day wirk rins throu three Core Circles. Ony Albion Faerie mey attend if they wish tae help.
involve.circlesCoreEvents: Gatherins & Events — owersees hou gatherins an events are organised.
involve.circlesRolesIntro: Roles relate tae tasks undertaken as service. A twal-month pledge is usually requestit; roles mey be shared. Major roles are askit tae find twa backups — an elder wi experience an a neophyte learnin intae the wirk. Convenors, Record-keepers, an local or specialist stewards come thegither as the Stewards Circle.
involve.circlesConvenorsBody: Keep ilk Core Circle meetin regularly, encourage attendance, arrange accessible venues, spot wha can lead issues, support facilitators, an keep an overview wi ither Stewards.
involve.circlesRecordsBody: Support Convenors; publicise meetins; ensure minutes are taen, circulated, stored, an followit throu; encourage skill-sharing; an co-ordinate wi ither Stewards. The three Convenors an three Record-keepers also liaise across Circles.
involve.circlesVolunteersBody: Facilitators an minute-takers are essential an can serve occasionally. Circles mey appoint workin-party leaders an specialist stewards — for example a Book-Keeper — wha pledge particular skills. Local stewards are still developin whaur eneuch faeries live nearby.

lugh.title: Gatherin call
lugh.tag: Template hearth for an Albion gatherin — the call, practicals, an hou tae help.
lugh.callBody: Callin Radical Faeries, Queer Spirits, Gay Witches, Drag Druids, hert circlers, fae newbies, an whae'er else ye mey be — welcome hame. Exact dates an place live under Gatherins & Events an in the newsletter whan bookins open.
lugh.practicalBody: Travel, beds or campin, whit tae bring, access notes, an care agreements belang on ilk gatherin's ain page — Featherstone, Glastonbury, or elsewhere.
lugh.helpBody: Kitchens, stewards, ritual hauders, an drivers mak the gatherin. Offer whit ye can; if ye want tae help plan, write tae Gatherins & Events.
